questions.prompt: The Ottoman Empire captured Constantinople in which year?
questions.fact: The city's fall ended the last continuous remnant of the Roman Empire, a thousand years after the west collapsed.

questions.prompt: Which branch of science studies earthquakes?
questions.fact: Earth's interior was mapped using earthquake waves — the core was discovered by noticing where waves failed to arrive.

questions.prompt: Which trophy is awarded to the winner of the Super Bowl?
questions.fact: Named for the coach who won the first two Super Bowls, and made by hand each year as a silver football on a stand.

questions.prompt: Which Pixar film features a rat who wants to be a chef?
questions.fact: The title dish was designed by a real chef, who reworked a rustic vegetable stew into something that would startle a critic.

questions.prompt: Which country is entirely within the Arabian Peninsula and borders only Saudi Arabia?
questions.fact: It is a peninsula with a single land border, and holds some of the largest natural gas reserves in the world.

questions.prompt: Which novel features a whale hunt led by Captain Ahab?
questions.fact: It sold poorly in Melville's lifetime and only became a classic decades after his death.

questions.prompt: Which company developed the Java programming language?
questions.fact: It was designed to run anywhere through a virtual machine — write once, run anywhere. Oracle acquired the company in 2010.
